::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 83,150 people lived in County Offaly, up 6.7% on 2016. It had the 19th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 57% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Offaly was €1,198, the 14th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Offaly

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Offaly was €26,969, the 16th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Offaly was €280,900, the 17th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 3.9 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Offaly, the 21st highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 23% of households in County Offaly rented their home, the 22nd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 14% of people living in County Offaly were born outside Ireland, the second lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 37% of people aged 3 and over in County Offaly said they could speak Irish, the 22nd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 26% of people at work in County Offaly worked from home for at least part of the week, the 21st highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Offaly went by car, the 16th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Offaly live more than 2.7 km by road from a GP, the 10th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Offaly live more than 20.1 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 15th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 10.8% of County Offaly in 2021, the 11th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
